title: CDC weekly update: 5,182 confirmed measles cases in 2026
detail: CDC's Nov 6 update (data through Nov 5) reports 5,182 confirmed 2026 cases, up 330 (6.8%) from 4,852 a week earlier — the 13th straight triple-digit weekly increase. 47 jurisdictions reported 5,164 cases (18 among international visitors); 96% (4,993) are outbreak-associated; about 11% hospitalized. Pennsylvania has 1,487 cases per CIDRAP; Wisconsin 477 (state count), Minnesota 139, New York 210, Indiana 134.

title: Pennsylvania reports sixth measles-associated death of 2026
detail: On Nov 4 Pennsylvania reported its sixth 2026 measles-associated death, an unvaccinated Jefferson County resident (identified by a funeral director as a 21-year-old woman who died after postpartum complications). New York and Wisconsin also reported deaths (a child and an infant) that week; state health departments count eight 2026 deaths while the CDC's official count is four.

media.caption: US measles total for 2026 tops 5,100 cases

title: PAHO commission to meet next week on US elimination status
detail: CIDRAP reports PAHO's regional commission meets next week in Washington, DC for its sixth annual measles and rubella elimination meeting; the US is widely expected to lose the elimination status held since 2000. Sources told CIDRAP the outcome is largely symbolic as many experts consider measles endemic.
